# Phone Repair Near Me

> Independent directory of phone repair shops across Greater Sydney, NSW. Compare screen, battery, charging port, back glass, camera and water-damage repair options by suburb, with store distance, hours and contact details.

Phone Repair Near Me helps people in any Sydney suburb find the closest listed phone repair store, see indicative pricing and get directions or a phone number. The directory is independent of any phone manufacturer. Every suburb and region has its own page at the site root, e.g. https://phonerepairnearme.com.au/bondi-beach/ — there is no /sydney/ or /services/ path prefix.

## Notes
- Each suburb page ranks the currently listed stores by straight-line distance from that suburb and shows live-computed opening hours.
- Store listings (name, address, phone, hours) are maintained directly by the site operator; only three physical stores are listed as of 2026-11-01, so distances on far suburb pages can be large — this is disclosed on the page itself.
- Suburb/region page copy is template-generated from a shared dataset; store details and pricing are not.
